ORDINANCE XXIX OF 1997
ORDINANCE XXIX OF 1997
INCOME TAX (SECOND AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance further to amend the
Income Tax Ordinance, 1979
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 15th February, 1997]
F.No.2(1)/97‑Pub., dated 14‑2‑1997
The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further to
amend the Income Tax Ordinance 1979 (XXXI of 1979), for the purposes
hereinafter appearing.
And Whereas the National Assembly is
not in session and. the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action.
Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may
be called the Income Tax (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force on the
day the Tax Adjustments Ordinance, 1996 (LXXXIX of 1996), shall stand repealed.

Amendment of the first schedule, Ordinance XXXI of 1979

2. Amendment of the first schedule,
Ordinance XXXI of 1979.‑‑In the Income‑tax Ordinance, 1979 (XXXI of 1979),
hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in the first schedule, in part
I,‑‑
(a) In paragraph CCC, in sub‑paragraph
(i),‑‑
(i) In clause (c), for the word
"Two" the word "Three" shall be substituted.
(ii) in clause (d), for the word
"Four" the word "Five" shall be substituted.
(b) In paragraph E, in paragraph
(i), in clause (c), for the word "two" the word "three"
shall be substituted, and
(c) In paragraph, F, for the word
"four" the word "five" shall be substituted.
